title: [Master]-Performance issue when calculating the VAT advance return / VAT statement (Base Application, German environment) - Copy
summary: Removed database keys from the VAT Entry table in CH and DACH environments to prevent performance degradation on CRUD operations, reverting an earlier attempt to address VAT statement calculation issues.
key_points: Deleted keys that were previously added to optimize VAT statement queries
Affects both Switzerland and DACH region VAT Entry tables
Protects CRUD performance on the VAT Entry table
